userStories.title: Prompt Library DB Table and GET API
userStories.description: Create the `prompt_library` table (migration 047) and a `GET /api/prompts` endpoint that returns bundled prompts (hardcoded in the route, never stored in DB) merged with workspace-custom prompts (stored in DB). Bundled prompts are returned first, custom prompts second, both sorted by name within their group.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration file `backend/src/db/migrations/047_prompt_library.sql` creates table `prompt_library (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', prompt_text TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))`
New route file `backend/src/routes/prompts.ts` exports an Express router
Route mounted in `backend/src/server.ts` as `app.use('/api/prompts', promptsRouter)`

`GET /api/prompts?workspaceId=<id>` returns `{ prompts: PromptEntry[] }` where `PromptEntry = { id: number | string, name: string, description: string | null, category: string, prompt_text: string, source: 'bundled' | 'custom', workspace_id: string | null, created_at: string }`

Bundled prompts are represented in-memory as a `BUNDLED_PROMPTS` constant array in `prompts.ts` — they are NOT stored in the DB. Each gets a string id prefixed `bundled-` (e.g. `bundled-0`, `bundled-1`)
Response merges bundled (always included, source='bundled') with workspace custom rows from DB (source='custom'). Bundled entries come first in the array
`workspaceId` query param is optional — if omitted, only bundled prompts are returned
Route has `@swagger` JSDoc annotation documenting operationId `listPrompts`
`npx tsc --noEmit` in backend passes with no new errors

userStories.title: Bundled Starter Prompt Set
userStories.description: Populate the `BUNDLED_PROMPTS` constant in `backend/src/routes/prompts.ts` with at least 15 curated prompts across 5+ categories. Each prompt should be a rich, actionable brief — not a one-liner — detailed enough to generate a solid spec when pasted into the forge textarea.
acceptanceCriteria: `BUNDLED_PROMPTS` array has at least 15 entries, each with `{ name, description, category, prompt_text }`
At least 5 distinct category values are represented across the entries. Suggested categories: 'auth', 'api', 'saas', 'cli', 'devops', 'data', 'security', 'mobile', 'payments'
Category 'auth' includes at least one prompt covering: signup, login, JWT tokens, password reset, email verification, session management, rate limiting
Category 'api' includes at least one prompt covering: REST CRUD endpoints, pagination, filtering, validation, error handling, OpenAPI spec
Category 'saas' includes at least one prompt covering: workspace/team model, invite system, role-based access, subscription tiers
Category 'payments' includes at least one prompt covering: Stripe checkout, webhook handler, subscription lifecycle, invoice history
Category 'devops' includes at least one prompt covering: CI/CD pipeline, Docker containerization, health check endpoints, environment config
Each `prompt_text` is at minimum 3 sentences and describes what to build with enough specificity to generate 5–15 user stories
Each `description` is a single sentence summarizing what the prompt builds (shown as subtitle in UI)

userStories.title: Custom Prompt CRUD API
userStories.description: Add `POST /api/prompts` to create workspace-custom prompts (stored in DB) and `DELETE /api/prompts/:id` to remove them. Bundled prompts cannot be deleted — return 403 if attempted.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/prompts` accepts `{ workspaceId: string, name: string, description?: string, category?: string, prompt_text: string }` — returns `{ prompt: PromptEntry }` with status 201
POST validates: `workspaceId` required (404 if workspace not found), `name` required (max 100 chars), `prompt_text` required (max 10000 chars), `category` defaults to 'custom' if omitted
POST inserts into `prompt_library` table, returns the newly created row with `source: 'custom'`
`DELETE /api/prompts/:id` accepts numeric string IDs only. Returns 204 on success
DELETE returns 403 with `{ error: 'Cannot delete bundled prompts' }` if `:id` starts with 'bundled-' or is not a valid integer
DELETE returns 404 if no DB row matches the given id
Both routes have `@swagger` JSDoc annotations (operationId: `createPrompt`, `deletePrompt`)
`npx tsc --noEmit` in backend passes

userStories.title: PromptLibraryModal Component
userStories.description: Create `src/components/PromptLibraryModal.tsx` — a searchable, category-filterable modal for browsing and selecting prompts. Follows the same visual pattern as `TemplatePickerModal.tsx`. Clicking a prompt entry calls `onSelect` with the prompt's text.
acceptanceCriteria: New file `src/components/PromptLibraryModal.tsx` exports a default React component
Props interface: `{ onClose: () => void; onSelect: (promptText: string) => void; workspaceId?: string }`
On mount, fetches `GET /api/prompts?workspaceId=<workspaceId>` via `apiFetch`. Shows skeleton rows while loading. Shows error message with retry button on failure
Search input is auto-focused on open. Typing filters prompts by `name`, `description`, and `prompt_text` (case-insensitive substring match in frontend — no additional API calls)

Category filter is a row of pill buttons above the list: 'All' (default selected) + one pill per distinct category present in the fetched results. Selecting a pill filters the list to that category. 'All' shows everything

Each list row shows: prompt name (font-medium, text-text), category badge (rounded pill, text-xs, muted background), description as subtitle (text-xs text-muted, single line, line-clamp-1), and first 80 chars of prompt_text as a preview line (text-xs text-muted/60, italic, line-clamp-1)
Clicking any row calls `onSelect(prompt.prompt_text)` and the modal closes
Keyboard navigation: Escape key calls `onClose`. Up/Down arrow keys move focus between prompt rows. Enter on a focused row selects it
Click outside the modal panel (on the backdrop) calls `onClose`
Empty state (no results after filtering): shows text 'No prompts match your search' and a 'Clear search' button that resets the search input
Modal renders inside a fixed full-screen backdrop with z-index above the forge panel. Panel is max-w-lg, max-h-[70vh], scrollable list
Imports only from existing dependencies (no new npm packages). Uses Tailwind classes consistent with the existing design system (bg-panel, border-border, text-accent, etc.)

userStories.title: Wire Prompt Library into New Spec Screen
userStories.description: Add a 'Browse prompt library' entry point in the New Spec (ForgeView) screen in `src/panels/SpecsPanel.tsx`. It appears below the existing 'Start from a template' row under the same show conditions. Selecting a prompt fills the brief textarea and focuses it.
acceptanceCriteria: In `src/panels/SpecsPanel.tsx` ForgeView component, add state: `const [showPromptLibrary, setShowPromptLibrary] = useState(false)` alongside the existing `showTemplatePicker` state
Add a second clickable row immediately below the 'Start from a template' button. It is only shown when `!specBrief.trim() && !generatedSpec && !isGenerating` (same conditions as the template row)

The new row has the same visual style as the template row (dashed border card, icon in accent/10 background, hover:border-accent/40). Icon: `BookOpen` from lucide-react (import it). Label: 'Browse prompt library'. Subtitle: 'Pick from starter prompts and agent instructions'
Clicking the row sets `showPromptLibrary(true)`

`PromptLibraryModal` is rendered at the bottom of the ForgeView return, conditionally: `{showPromptLibrary && <PromptLibraryModal workspaceId={workspaceId ?? undefined} onClose={() => setShowPromptLibrary(false)} onSelect={(text) => { setSpecBrief(text); setShowPromptLibrary(false); setTimeout(() => briefRef.current?.focus(), 50); }} />}`
`PromptLibraryModal` is imported at the top of the file: `import PromptLibraryModal from '../components/PromptLibraryModal'`
After selecting a prompt: the textarea is populated with the prompt text, the modal is closed, and the textarea receives focus
`npx tsc --noEmit` in the frontend root passes with no new type errors
The feature is visually tested: open New Spec → both rows visible (template + prompt library) → click prompt library → modal opens → search filters → click prompt → textarea populated
